IMO, taking a piece of content from good to great is not that mysterious. Here's how I break it down:
If it's relevant to you, fits what you're building toward, people can understand it without having to guess what you're saying, and helps people see or do something different, by all means, that's a great piece. All the other stuff…the art, the visuals, the analogies, the examples…that's just the cherry on top.
I'd also be careful with overpolishing your work. When it comes to social media, it all boils down to testing, testing, testing and (you guessed) testing. You'll never know what great is until people respond to it. That's just how it is.
